title: WhatsApp Lets You React to Messages with Stickers — Up to 20 Stickers on a Single Message! 😄
body: WhatsApp Lets You React to Messages with Stickers — Up to 20 Stickers on a Single Message! 😄
WhatsApp is testing a new feature that lets you reply to any message with a sticker from your own collection, instead of just one emoji reaction.
A sticker is a small, fun image that expresses your feelings, and both static and animated stickers can be used together.
The feature allows up to 20 sticker reactions on a single message, compared to just one emoji reaction before.
The feature has now reached some testers of the Android beta version, and will expand gradually over the coming weeks; no date has been announced for when it will reach everyone.
Which sticker do you use more than any other? 🎭
